description:
Position Description
   

  

 We are seeking an energetic and experienced Scrum Master with 3 to 6 years of experience to lead our Agile teams. In this role, you will champion Agile and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles, facilitate key ceremonies, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in tracking tools like JIRA and excels at data\-driven reporting to drive continuous team improvement.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure team alignment and momentum.
   

  

 Scale with SAFe: Guide the team through SAFe practices, aligning delivery with Program Increment (PI) objectives and cross\-team dependencies.
   

  

 Track \& Report Metrics: Leverage JIRA to manage backlogs, track workflows, and generate actionable reports (e.g., velocity, burndown/burnup charts, cumulative flow) for stakeholders.
   

  

 Remove Impediments: Proactively identify, track, and resolve blockers to protect the team's focus and velocity.
   

  

 Coach \& Mentor: Foster a culture of psychological safety, continuous improvement, and self\-organization within the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience working as a Scrum Master in software development environments.
   

  

 Certification: Mandatory SAFe Certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master \- SSM or SAFe Agilist \- SA).
   

  

 Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of Agile frameworks, Scrum values, Kanban principles, and scaling patterns.
   

  

 Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on expertise with JIRA (creating custom dashboards, filters, epics, and advanced reporting).
   

  

 Communication \& Collaboration: Exceptional stakeholder management, conflict\-resolution, and transparent reporting skills.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

description:
Seeking a Scrum Master (7\-8 yrs of exp) to lead cross\-functional delivery, manage complex Subscription and end\-to\-end Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) dependencies, and drive Agile maturity across high\-impact business and engineering teams. The ideal candidate will orchestrate predictable, enterprise\-grade releases across integrated Salesforce and Zuora ecosystems while relentlessly removing systemic blockers.
   

  

**Agile Leadership \& Coaching**
* Facilitate Core Ceremonies: Lead high\-value Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives with an emphasis on continuous improvement.
* Agile Maturity \& Governance: Coach product teams, engineering leads, and business stakeholders on Agile/Scrum best practices, metrics, and empirical process control.
* Metrics \& Reporting: Establish and track delivery metrics (Velocity, Burn\-down/Burn\-up, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Density) to drive data\-informed improvements.


**Backlog, Scope \& Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Product Owners: Assist POs and Business Analysts in breaking down epic\-level Quote\-to\-Cash requirements into well\-defined, actionable user stories with clear Acceptance Criteria.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Bridge communication between non\-technical business units (Sales Operations, Finance, Billing Ops) and technical engineering/integration teams.
* Scope Creep Control: Protect the team’s sprint commitments while managing changing business priorities typical in CRM and billing transformations.


**Impediment Removal \& Risk Management**
* Technical \& Process Blockers: Proactively identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks across teams (e.g., third\-party API rate limits, schema mismatches between Salesforce and Zuora, or stalled UAT sign\-offs).
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Coordinate with external vendor teams, Salesforce/Zuora SI partners, and internal enterprise architecture or QA teams to maintain momentum.
* Risk Mitigation: Maintain a risk register for high\-impact enterprise rollouts, ensuring fallback plans exist for data migrations and critical system go\-lives.


**Technical and Domain Expertise/Expectations**
* Scrum/SAFe
* Azure Devops/ADO/Servicenow
* Scrum Master Certified / SAFe Certified
* Zuora/Salesforce Basic Knowledge ( Good to have )

description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will drive agile delivery excellence across cross\-functional teams, enabling the successful delivery of strategic business and technology outcomes. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and work closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to maximize value delivery and team performance.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile delivery leadership within Scrum and/or SAFe environments
* Facilitating Agile ceremonies and driving continuous improvement
* Managing dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder engagement
* Agile tooling such as Jira, Confluence, and reporting dashboards


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), CSM, PSM or equivalent Agile certification
* Experience supporting large\-scale transformation and change initiatives
* Data\-driven delivery management using metrics and KPIs
* Financial Services, Payments, Banking, or Regulatory programme experience


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific Agile delivery and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

**About The Role**
 Every sprint that ships depends on someone keeping ceremonies structured, blockers visible, and Jira data trustworthy. Without that, planning drifts, standups run long without resolving anything, and status reports stop reflecting what teams shipped. The Scrum Master owns that day\-to\-day discipline for one or more Platform teams, especially teams still building their agile habits, so the team can focus on delivery instead of process friction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Ceremony Facilitation**
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for assigned teams, keeping sessions time\-boxed and outcome\-focused

* Maintain Jira boards and backlog health for assigned teams, keeping stories current and sprints configured correctly

description:
**Summary**
 The Software Engineering Lead is a hands\-on subject matter expert, engineering leader and people manager responsible for a cross\-functional team delivering a defined set of products and services. This role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, and people management.
   

  

 The Lead sets technical direction, ensures technical and operational excellence, and partners with Product to deliver business outcomes. Through their direct team; ensures designs have effective architectural and structural oversight, reliable products are delivered. As a peer to a Principal Software Engineer, this role is accountable for engineering outcomes (quality, reliability, security, compliance, cost, and speed) and for cultivating a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture. Analyses and aligns product roadmaps and determines the technical feasibility of future development projects. In addition will provide direction into delivery plans, schedules, raises risks and updated roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountable for ensuring good management to oversee and continuously improve the quality, service, and efficiency of staff, products and processes. Follows and enforces necessary compliance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Culture**
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws
* Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture; resolve conflict constructively; model One\-Team behaviours.
* Provides effective line management to direct reports and acts as an independent escalation point
* Conduct standard HR related duties such as absence management, performance management, disciplinaries, addressing complaints and resolving problem
* Participate in hiring processes, interviewing and develop onboarding plans of new team members
* Ensure all staff are provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible.
* Coach, mentor and support the professional development of individuals, provide with frequent feedback in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently; fostering autonomy and ownership


**Product \& Delivery Excellence**
* Own delivery outcomes: predictability, throughput, quality, and customer value—using metrics (e.g., cycle time, lead time, escaped defects, change failure rate).
* Drive planning, capacity \& dependency management; ensure delivery plans are feasible and transparent.
* Balance product growth opportunities with technical enablement (tech debt, reliability, security) using clear trade\-off decisions.
* Serve as engineering voice in roadmap prioritisation and discovery; ensure requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to architecture constraints.
* Collaborate with direct reports and various stakeholders to support the development and maintenance of the technical roadmap, ensuring roadmap planning is well thought out technically and will be successful
* Proactively surface risks and mitigations; manage external dependencies and vendor/partner engagement.
* Serve as the initial point of escalation for software development issues within the specific area of responsibility leading on
* Manage and encourage new ideas from team members to foster improvements through innovations
* Interface with Product, UX, other technical personnel, or team members to finalise requirements
* Write and reviews portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity
* Work closely with other development team members to understand moderately complex product requirements and translate them into software designs
* Ensure platform and features are compliant


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**
* Align with domain/platform tech leads and the architecture function to drive standards, patterns, and reusability.
* Collaborate with team and domain tech leads on platform architecture, cross functional requirements and complex data models
* Ensure API and integration designs are robust, reliable and fault tolerant, versioned, observable, secure, and well\-documented.
* Ensure sufficient \& relevant technical documentation is available so that any staff can get up to speed quickly with the technical concerns of the product and services leading on
* Maintain a healthy technical estate: modernisation, simplification, deprecations; manage technical debt with a transparent backlog and guardrails, so that the technical burden is kept in equilibrium
* Provide technical assurance for the team: designs, code quality, reviews, and architectural alignment.
* Ensure security practices and standards are adopted within the team leading and acceptance criteria, with regular security testing is scheduled across all products and services leading on
* Ensure suitable dashboards are developed and enhanced to highlight technical concerns, risks and KPIs
* Keep abreast of new technology developments
* Lead system design at scale, using ADRs, C4 or similar; ensure architectural decisions are traceable and pragmatic.
* Champion modern design principles: SOLID, DDD, event\-driven architectures, CQRS where appropriate.


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure zero/minimal downtime deployments (blue/green, canary); enforce release readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices and operational processes
* Own operational readiness: instrumentation, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerts; production “run” quality.
* Define SLIs/SLOs/SLA and error budgets; drive MTTR, availability, and performance targets.
* Lead incident response and blameless post\-incident reviews; ensure actionable follow\-ups and learning loops
* Ensure software is maintained and upgrade as appropriate
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) plans and are well practiced; ensure compliance for resilience and recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).
* Ensure suitable testing is in place for all services and external interfaces managed are performant, scalable, fault tolerant, reliable and future capacity modelling is considered and performance targets are in defined
* Resolve complex technical issues and complete complex bug fixes as necessary
* Own cloud cost awareness (FinOps\-lite): budgeting inputs, cost\-to\-serve, scaling policies, right\-sizing, elasticity.
* Drive performance efficiency: load testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, and scalable architectures.


**Qualifications**
* A polygot with a wide range of experience of different technologies and systems
* Proven experience as a Tech Lead / Lead Engineer delivering software at scale
* Strong organizational and project planning, time management and change management skills across functional groups
* Advanced problem solving and leading/co\-ordinating people across teams as necessary to troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues and get beyond symptoms to identifying root cause
* Focus more on the design and configuration of new systems to meet user requirements than on the implementation, technical support and evaluation of existing systems
* Demonstrable success leading cross\-functional teams through full SDLC to production.
* Experience in systems analysis, design and a solid understanding of development, quality assurance and integration methodologies
* Experienced developing integrated solutions within a broad technical and business context of significant impact
* Experience balancing product delivery with technical investments (security, reliability, debt).
* Experienced in evaluating and participated in competitive analysis of 3rd party software and services
* Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills
* Skilled in stakeholder management and communicating effectively at multiple levels (engineers → executives)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field of work or equivalent work experience \#


**Skills**
* Advanced knowledge of agile software development methodologies (Scrum, XP, Pair programming, 3\-Amigos, DevSecOps )
* Expertise in various development languages and interfaces such as c\#/.netcore, JavaScript (JQuery, ReactJS), Java, Node.Js, Python, Web, MVC, Restful APIs, GraphQL, CSS, Swagger
* Strong knowledge of SOLID Principles, KISS, YAGANI, Design patterns, Domain Modelling, DDD, CQRS, Event Driven Architectures, micro\-services and message Queues, feature toggles, SOA, and software\-as\-a\-service
* Broad knowledge of Continuous Testing, TDD / BDD, Integration Tests, Performance \& Scalability Testing, Instrumentation (Logging, monitoring, alerting, metrics, health checks)
* Strong knowledge of relational and document based data stores, with strong understanding of normalised/dimensional data modelling principles and data manipulation languages including optimisation techniques
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, Security \& Privacy By Design, SAST/DAST, Encryption, TLS, Secure Coding, Threat Modelling
* Strong knowledge of cloud based hosting, IaC, Immutable Infrastructure and container solutions, and cost/efficiency optimisations
* Strong knowledge of Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Source Control, Build Orchestration, Artefact Repositories, Static Analysis, powershell, green\-blue deployments and canary releases.


**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Scrum Master - AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master \- AVP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master \- AVP, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices.
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation.
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices.
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures.
* Ability to take e2e accountability of team delivering a quality product increment in every release.
* Ability to provide situational servant leadership to the team.
* Ability to manage complex projects in banking at enterprise scale.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing risks, issues, and dependencies.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 



  





**Lead Release Management Specialist.** 




**Function:** 
 Group Technology Operations (GTO) – Actuarial Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Skills Screening Summary:** 




**Who are we:** 




 Actuary IT Solutions is Zurich’s global capability within Finance, Investment \& Treasury (FIT), responsible for running, stabilising, and evolving shared actuarial platforms supporting IFRS and Group Reporting.
 



 Our portfolio includes core actuarial platforms such as
 **ACE, GNLA, GRAND and GLAD** 
 , operated as shared services with clear ownership, measurable KPIs and standardised processes. We are actively modernising this landscape, including a major migration to AWS targeted for Go\-Live in Q1 2027, to improve resilience, speed, cost efficiency and long\-term sustainability.
 



 India is an integral part of our global delivery model, working closely with international teams to support platform operations, change and transformation initiatives across the actuarial ecosystem.
 



  





**Why you’ll love working here:** 



* **Enterprise\-critical impact** 
 – Work on platforms supporting Zurich’s IFRS and Group Reporting.
* **Complex, meaningful delivery** 
 – Coordinate releases across globally used, multi\-component actuarial platforms.
* **Transformation at pace** 
 – Play a key role in the AWS migration programme.
* **AI\-enabled ways of working** 
 – Support AI\-first engineering, testing, operations and knowledge management.
* **Global collaboration** 
 – Work with teams across Hyderabad, Barcelona and other global locations.
* **Ownership and accountability** 
 – Drive decisions, solve complex problems and deliver measurable outcomes.



 If you enjoy working at the intersection of
 **release excellence and Agile delivery leadership** 
 , this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to platforms critical to Zurich’s financial reporting and regulatory outcomes.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 The
 **Release Manager \& Scrum Master** 
 will manage the end\-to\-end release lifecycle for the
 **ACE actuarial platform** 
 while leading Agile delivery for a geo\-dispersed team.
 



 This is a dual\-purpose role requiring strong ownership of release planning, coordination, governance and production readiness, alongside hands\-on Scrum Master responsibilities. The role acts as a key bridge between Hyderabad and global stakeholders, requiring proactive communication, strong stakeholder management and the ability to manage complexity under pressure.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Release Management:** 



* Own the end\-to\-end release lifecycle, including planning, scheduling, coordination and deployment across multiple environments and integrated components.
* Maintain release calendars, change windows and release plans aligned with business and regulatory timelines.
* Coordinate release readiness across Engineering, Testing and Business teams, ensuring required sign\-offs, test evidence and change controls are completed.
* Manage hotfixes, emergency releases and production incidents with structured communication and minimal business disruption.
* Maintain end\-to\-end release traceability through Azure DevOps.

**Keep four squads honest about what they can actually ship** 




 You will run the full Scrum ceremony set, including standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retros, for two to three product squads inside a single business unit, adjusting the ceremony rhythm per squad rather than forcing one template on all of them.
 



 You will track velocity, burndown and cross\-squad dependencies, and flag the ones that are actually going to blow a release date versus the ones that will resolve themselves.
 



 You will coach product managers and engineering leads on writing stories that can actually be estimated, and push back when a story arrives with the acceptance criteria still in someone's head.
 



 You will represent delivery status upward, translating sprint\-level noise into a release picture that a VP of Engineering can act on without five follow\-up questions.
 



 This role expects four to eight years of Scrum Master or agile delivery experience, including time spent supporting more than one team at once. You should be comfortable with Jira at an administrator level, know the difference between a blocked story and a slow one, and have said no to a scope change mid\-sprint at least once. A Scrum or SAFe certification helps but is not the bar, the bar is having run this before and having the scars to show for it.
 



**The team you would be supporting** 




 This is a US\-headquartered product company scaling its India engineering hub, hiring this role through Flexiple. The India engineering org is a little over sixty people today, organised into four squads that this role will rotate support across.
 



 Bengaluru, Pune or Remote (India), with a strong preference for candidates able to overlap a few hours with the US product team.
 



 Expect a recruiter conversation, a scenario\-based round on running a multi\-squad sprint cadence, a session with two of the engineering leads you would support, and a closing conversation with the hiring manager.
 



 This application is also kept on file for other delivery and agile\-coaching roles Flexiple is hiring for alongside this one.

If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.*
***What does a Technical Lead do at WPP Production?***
*We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Technical Lead with deep expertise in Sitecore XM Cloud and the broader Sitecore composable ecosystem. As a Technical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping digital experience platforms, leading engineering teams, and driving the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale solutions. You will provide technical leadership across Sitecore XM Cloud, Sitecore AI, Headless SXA, Experience Edge, Next.js, and composable architecture patterns. The role requires a strong focus on solution architecture, technical governance, integration strategy, and the adoption of AI\-driven content and personalization capabilities.*
***Reporting lines and key stakeholders***
*This role reports into the Head of Digital Technology*
**Key Role Responsibilities**
  Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical leadership, architectural guidance, and support across Sitecore XM Cloud and composable DXP implementations.
   

  

  Drive the technical direction, solution architecture, and implementation strategy for Sitecore XM Cloud, Headless SXA, Next.js, and composable digital experience platforms.
   

  

  Establish and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, security requirements, and quality assurance processes across all phases of delivery.
   

  

  Design and deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications using modern technologies such as Next.js, React, .NET, and cloud\-native services.
   

  

  Lead the implementation of Sitecore XM Cloud solutions, leveraging Experience Edge, Headless Services, and modern front\-end frameworks.
   

  

  Design and develop APIs, integrations, microservices, and event\-driven solutions to support composable architectures and enterprise digital ecosystems.
   

  

  Collaborate with front\-end engineers to ensure seamless integration between Sitecore XM Cloud, external services, and customer\-facing digital experiences.
   

  

  Demonstrate strong expertise across the Sitecore ecosystem, including XM Cloud, Headless SXA, Experience Edge, Sitecore AI, Personalize, Search, and Content Hub.
   

  

  Drive the adoption of Sitecore AI capabilities to improve content creation, content operations, search experiences, personalization, and digital engagement.
   

  

  Stay current with emerging trends in composable architecture, AI\-powered digital experiences, cloud technologies, and the Sitecore product roadmap.
   

  

  Provide technical leadership and recommendations on architecture patterns, platform capabilities, scalability, security, and long\-term technology strategy.
   

  

  Work closely with delivery managers and project managers to define scope, timelines, resource requirements, and technical dependencies.
   

  

  Identify, manage, and mitigate technical risks, ensuring successful delivery of high\-quality solutions that align with business objectives and enterprise standards.
   

  

  Support solutioning, and RFP activities by defining technical approaches, estimating effort, creating solution architectures, and presenting solutions to stakeholders.
   

  


**Key Candidate Requirements**
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
   

  

  Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Senior Full Stack Engineer, or Solution Architect delivering enterprise\-scale digital experience platforms.
   

  

  Strong expertise in Sitecore XM Cloud and/or Umbraco CMS, including headless and composable architecture implementations.
   

  

  Experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications using modern development practices.
   

  

  Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
   

  

  Strong experience with .NET, ASP.NET Core, C\#, and server\-side application development.
   

  

  Hands\-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
   

  

  Solid understanding of composable architecture principles, headless CMS implementations, and API\-first development.
   

  

  Experience integrating CMS platforms with third\-party systems, enterprise applications, and cloud services.

title: Agile Scrum Master Senior Analyst- Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Job Role:** Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach


About Cigna


Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.


Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.


We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.

**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.


This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.

**About the Role**
==================


The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.


The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.


This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Coaching and Agile Enablement**
--------------------------------------

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.

**Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.

**Facilitation and Cadence Events**
-----------------------------------

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.

**ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments**
------------------------------------------------

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.

**Success in this Role**
========================

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.

**Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
=================================================

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* At least 4 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, **Kanban practices**, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.
* Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.

**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
================================================

* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.

**About Cigna Healthcare**


Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. 8\+ years across Atlassian administration/SME work and enterprise training or enablement leadership; deep hands\-on Jira and Confluence knowledge (cloud experience strongly preferred).

Strong content\-development craft across written, video, and live formats; comfort with LMS and content tooling.
  
Facilitation excellence in both technical and non\-technical rooms.
  
  

PREFERRED
  
  

Prior enablement work on a Data Center\-to\-Cloud (or equivalent platform) migration.
  
Experience partnering with formal OCM functions and communications teams.
  
Familiarity with adoption analytics and sentiment measurement.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 As a trained Scrum Master, you are responsible for facilitating a Scrum team and are accountable for removing impediments of the team to achieve the sprint goals/deliverables. You are responsible to ensure that the Scrum process is used as intended. A key part of your role is to protect the development team, allow the teams  to be self managed, foster collaboration across teams and keep them focused on the tasks at hand.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* Is accountable for meeting Sprint objectives along with scrum team
* Ensure meeting of sprint commitment
* Own and help resolve impediments of the team
* Help PO adopt Scrum Process properly and ensure PO availability
* Support the PO in maintaining the Product Backlog, defining User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate estimation, backlog refinement and all planning ceremonies
* Ensure that DOR, DOD, Acceptance criteria is available and adhered to
* Ensure MoSCoW adherence of Sprint Backlog at the Sprint level
* Accountable for the correct implementation of the Agile Process
* Protect the team from external interference.
* Facilitate technical assistance to the team and enables clear communication amongst the team members
* Participate in Scrum of Scrum across teams and highlights impediments
* Provide feedback on the team members performance to the Agile Line manager and Agile Program Leader
* Facilitate all the Scrum Ceremonies (Planning, Daily Standup, Grooming, Demo, restrospection) and ensure correct adoption


 ͏
 * Ensure updating of all Scrum artifacts
* Ensure ALM tool (either client or Wipro) is updated on a daily basis
* Update key Scrum metrics into Wipro internal tool on a Sprint\-by\-Sprint basis
* Analyse key Scrum metrics and take corrective actions
* Create competency improvement and cross\-skilling plan for the team (by the start of the project). Review monthly and ensure improvement in competency score. Ensure multiskilling for at least 50% of the team.
* Help team attain stable velocity within 6\-8 sprints (allowing for 10% variation either way)
* Train team on the proper adoption of Agile processes  (Scrum / XP / Kanban)
* Help in adoption of engineering practices like ATDD, TDD, CI, CD, Refactoring
* Record and own the restrospection actions
* Participate in community of practice initiatives
* Provide inputs to the Line manager for internal quality forums (QIC  / APR / QBR / MBR etc.)

title: Manager, SW System & Solution Dev Engineer
description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.

* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience building and developing high\-performing engineering teams.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About us**


Camascope India is part of Person\-Centred Software (PCS) Group who are, a fast\-growing technology group focused on empowering the care and medication sector. Following PCS's acquisition of Camascope, our India team continues to build the products that connect pharmacies, care homes and doctors — now as part of a larger, international engineering organisation serving thousands of care professionals every day. This role is dedicated to a PCS product, working closely with our UK product engineering teams.

**What you will work on**


As Engineering Manager, you will build and lead a new team of 6 engineers in India delivering a PCS product, working closely with a counterpart engineering team in the UK. You will start hands\-on contributing directly to code for roughly half your time — while establishing team practices, hiring, and delivery rhythm. As the team matures and grows (including a planned second team under your leadership), your contribution will shift from hands\-on coding toward team leadership, coaching and cross\-team coordination.

**Responsibilities**

* Hire, build and lead a new engineering team of 6 in India, growing the team's capability and, over time, a second team under the same remit
* Contribute hands\-on to design, engineering and delivery of features — approximately 50% of your time initially, tapering as the team scales and matures
* Own day\-to\-day team operations — sprint delivery, 1:1s, performance management, hiring and career development
* Work closely with the UK product engineering team to align on delivery scope, priorities and technical direction for the shared PCS product
* Champion continuous delivery, with testing and security embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and promote DevSecOps practices across the team
* Make significant contributions to technical and architectural decisions, keeping systems, standards and practices coherent with the wider PCS engineering organisation
* Identify and remove blockers, process inefficiencies and technical debt proactively
* Be accountable for the full software development lifecycle — from design through to production, monitoring and support
* Foster a learning and mentoring culture; actively coach engineers and help them grow
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA and Design to achieve shared product outcomes

**Requirements**

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience as an Engineering Manager or senior technical lead of a team, with a strong portfolio of C\#/.NET applications
* Deep understanding of the C\#/.NET ecosystem, and experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) and cloud\-native development
* Experience with modern DevOps/CI\-CD practices
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design, security (e.g. OWASP API Security) and system architecture at scale
* Proven experience building and leading a team from the ground up — hiring, structuring, and establishing delivery practices for a new team
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across distributed or international teams
* Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and coaching a team on them
* Good understanding of database technologies, message queues, and data security
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a fix\-forward, learning mindset
* Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience working with, or managing engineers who use, AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot)

**Bonus points for**

* Experience managing or growing a second team, or scaling an engineering org from one team to several
* Prior experience in healthcare, care or pharmacy technology, or another highly regulated environment
* Experience with cloud migration projects or multi\-cloud environments
* Prior experience in a post\-acquisition or newly integrated engineering organisation
* Hands\-on experience with Blazor (web) and/or Maui (mobile)

description:

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Scrum Master \& Platform Reporting Analyst – ServiceNow Platform**
 The Scrum Master \& Platform Reporting Analyst supports the ServiceNow platform team by enabling Agile delivery, facilitating ceremonies, and driving continuous improvement, while also owning platform reporting, metrics, and analytics to support data\-driven decision\-making across the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Facilitate Scrum and Kanban ceremonies for assigned platform streams.
* Support demand management and prioritization, working alongside the Senior Scrum Master on backlog intake and sequencing.

* Prepare executive\-level presentations and reports.
* Fluent English is mandatory, as the role requires daily collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.
* Own overall reporting, metrics, and KPIs, measuring performance improvements and flagging areas that are underperforming.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for senior management, covering backlog health, closure time, and throughput trends.
* Support measurement of ROI for the ServiceNow platform.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or in a similar Agile delivery support role.
* Experience with the ServiceNow platform.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4, ITILv5 or ITSM concepts.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum and Kanban frameworks.
* Experience using Jira.
* Experience supporting technology or platform teams.
* Experience building reports and dashboards for leadership audiences (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow Performance Analytics).
* Scrum, PMP, or Kanban certification is a plus.

title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

**Required Skills**
**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including 3–5\+ years in people leadership roles
* Proven experience managing medium\-to\-large, complex programs with multiple dependencies
* Experience in financial services or brokerage domain preferred Technical \& Leadership Expertise
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and enterprise software engineering practices
* Experience building and operating highly available, scalable distributed systems
* Hands\-on experience or strong exposure to mainframe and modern distributed ecosystems


**AI \& Modern Engineering Capabilities**
* Demonstrated experience driving AI\-assisted engineering adoption \& AI\-DLC
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants) and their application in enterprise environments
* Understanding of automation, agentic workflows, and AI\-driven productivity acceleration (preferred practical exposure)
* Leadership \& Soft Skills
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and talent development capabilities
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, globally distributed environments
* Self\-starter with strong prioritization and multitasking capabilities


**Technical Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, propose and implement timely, cost effective, quality solutions for all issues or problems within area of responsibility
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate technical discussions and drive solutions forward to achieve business needs and ensure alignment to strategic technology vision
* Demonstrated experience with designing or working with highly available and reliable systems including work on technical design, defining SLAs, KPIs for tracking and improving software reliability
* Experience facilitating issue intervention and driving improvements
* Skills in risks identification, tracking and planned mitigation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and continuous delivery practices
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Rally, ChangeMan, BMC Remedy
* Experience leading large\-scale modernization programs using GenAI and automation
* Proven ability to drive innovation, strategic initiatives, and cross\-functional programs
* Experience building inclusive, high\-performance team cultures
* Managing Performance – Goal setting, coaching, and performance management
* Fostering Teamwork – Driving collaboration and team effectiveness
* Results Orientation – Delivering measurable outcomes aligned to business goals
* Strategic Thinking – Driving long\-term vision and transformation
* Fostering Diversity – Promoting inclusion and equitable practices
* Written \& Verbal Communication – Clear articulation across audience


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance


 Apply

description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**  

As a Scrum Master, you'll bring expertise in Agile methodologies and practices, supporting teams to achieve successful outcomes. You'll facilitate productive and purposeful meetings where every voice is heard and outcomes are clear. You'll help teams work towards sprint goals and objectives, remove obstacles, and support sustainable delivery towards releases.


Your coaching will help teams take responsibility for their processes, and your ability to identify early signs of conflict will help address challenges before they escalate. If you have experience coaching and advising teams, and would like to work in an open, inclusive and diverse culture where ideas and different perspectives are valued, we'd love to hear from you.


Job Responsibilities

* **Ceremonies** – facilitate key Agile ceremonies and planning activities, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, sprint retrospectives and release planning, to support collaboration and transparency.
* **Supporting estimation** – guide the team in estimating user stories and tasks, supporting shared understanding and realistic sprint commitments.
* **Removing impediments** – identify and resolve impediments that affect team progress by working with stakeholders and external groups, helping the team remain focused on sprint and release objectives. Represent the team in Scrum of Scrums and other cross\-team coordination meetings where required.
* **Collaborating with Product Owners** – work closely with Product Owners to maintain a prioritised and visible product backlog and support adherence to agreed priorities and scope.
* **Sprint focus** – guide the team in maintaining focus on sprint goals and release deliverables.
* **Team development** – support team development by helping teams address challenges, resolve conflicts, manage interpersonal issues and access development opportunities that strengthen overall effectiveness.
* **Continuous improvement** – facilitate retrospectives and support the team in identifying and implementing improvements to processes and ways of working.
* **Promoting Agile principles and practices** – guide the team in applying Agile frameworks and methodologies, with a focus on quality outcomes and delivery capability.
* **Facilitating readiness for demos and releases** – support preparation for stakeholder demonstrations and releases, ensuring readiness for key milestones.
* **Contributing to the Agile community of practice** – collaborate with other Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners to share knowledge, promote effective practices and strengthen Agile capability across the organisation.

  

**Qualifications**  

Essential Requirements

* 7\+ years of total experience.
* Experience applying Agile methodologies and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings that are purposeful, engaging and effective.
* Experience working with multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience coaching teams and encouraging responsibility for team processes.
* Ability to identify early signs of team conflict and apply appropriate resolution approaches.
* Ability to operate as both a day\-to\-day coach and adviser.


Desirable Requirements

* Experience representing teams within Scrum of Scrums or similar cross\-team forums.
* Experience contributing to Agile communities of practice.
* Experience supporting organisational Agile capability development.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Version 1?


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.


Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.


We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific Agile delivery and stakeholder management skills.


The role is based out of Pune, India.


**Purpose of the role**


Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.


**Accountabilities**


1\.Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
  

2\.Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
  

3\.Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
  

4\.Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
  

5\.Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
  

6\.Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
  

7\.Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable  

  



**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  

Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  

If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  

OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  

Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  

Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  

Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  

Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
  

Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  

Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  

Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  

Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

  

  

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager, Technical Professional Services
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Manager, Technical Professional Services
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
